user_target_1708.statement: Owner identified the available target hardware as Xbox One model 1708.
user_target_1708.scope: Target hardware identification by owner; not a measurement of dimensions or physical parameters

ifixit_1708_buttons.locator: Steps 7, 8, 14 and 16; step 14 explicitly identifies the connect/sync button retained by the face plate
ifixit_1708_buttons.scope: 1708 D-pad removal, removable stick caps, bumper retention, connect/sync control identity and rubber button backing
ifixit_1708_buttons.limitation: No force curves or joint frame dimensions. Do not import apparent screw-length typos as dimensions.

w3c_gamepad_standard_mapping.locator: Standard Gamepad table: buttons 0-16 and axes 0-3
w3c_gamepad_standard_mapping.scope: Canonical logical ordering and normalized ranges for four axes and seventeen buttons
w3c_gamepad_standard_mapping.limitation: W3C defines logical inputs, not an Xbox mechanical topology or this project's axes-then-buttons tensor concatenation.

apple_1708_connect_button.locator: Supported controllers and Pair and connect the controller
apple_1708_connect_button.scope: Identifies Xbox Wireless Controller with Bluetooth Model 1708 and instructs pressing its Connect button
apple_1708_connect_button.limitation: Confirms control identity and function only; supplies no dimensions, force, travel or mechanism topology.

microsoft_1708_dimensions.locator: Page 1, Product Dimensions; FCC/IC ID identifies Model 1708
microsoft_1708_dimensions.scope: Model 1708 whole-controller width, length, height and battery-loaded mass recorded in sources/1708_dimensions.json
microsoft_1708_dimensions.limitation: No dimensional tolerance is published. Whole-controller dimensions do not validate a third-party mesh's local geometry or mechanical revision.

batony_xbox_one_s_visual.author: BatonyRobson
batony_xbox_one_s_visual.locator: Downloaded 2K GLB SHA-256 5c5671c83a9cf15db4b8399e7010aa7d5cde915687ceb348b583eb00b0ed24e2; static 16-part export manifest in results/xbox_one_s_batonyrobson_UNVERIFIED/static_visual_parts_inventory_UNCALIBRATED.json
batony_xbox_one_s_visual.scope: Appearance-acknowledged Xbox One S visual candidate with sixteen named movable parts and embedded 2K materials.
batony_xbox_one_s_visual.limitation: The user acknowledged visual similarity only. Controller revision, metric dimensions, hidden geometry, pivots and mechanics are not verified; this source cannot establish a 1708 digital twin.

batony_artist_motion_prior.locator: Blender 4.5.9 audit summarized in results/xbox_one_s_batonyrobson_UNVERIFIED/artist_animation_summary_UNCALIBRATED.json; full audit SHA-256 4c97d513d66f008e5cbc2b375d3c98692cfb495ecf32178c42d399304b31e6df retained on the GPU node
batony_artist_motion_prior.scope: Candidate rest pivots, motion directions and displayed endpoint excursions for an explicitly labelled appearance-matched estimated-v0 kinematic preview.
batony_artist_motion_prior.limitation: Artist keyframes are neither measurements nor manufacturer specifications. They provide no target-revision identity, forces, mass, inertia, friction, damping, activation threshold or real-time response.

xbox_visual.scope: Non-dimensionally-correct Xbox One overlay model; not a mechanical drawing
xbox_visual.limitation: Per-model upstream attribution is unspecified. Object names establish visual labels only, not hardware topology, dimensions or pivots.

xbox_scan.locator: FabQuinn Xbox Series Controller(Standard, 3D scan), published 2023-12-26
xbox_scan.scope: Single scan mesh without independently identified controls; physical scale not independently verified
xbox_scan.limitation: Do not combine Series scan and Xbox One overlay as though they describe one calibrated revision.

alpakka_specs.scope: Alpakka reference design only, not the user's Xbox
alpakka_specs.limitation: Digital trigger switches are not Xbox analog trigger assemblies.

alps_stick.scope: RKJXV122400R component; Xbox component match unconfirmed
alps_stick.limitation: Operating torque does not specify a spring curve; tolerances are not probability distributions.

alps_front.locator: Basic information: operating force, travel; Specifications: soft feeling type
alps_front.scope: SKPMAME010 component used in Alpakka, not verified Xbox ABXY
alps_front.limitation: Force and travel scalars do not determine loading/unloading curves.

alps_shoulder.locator: Basic information: side push, force, travel; member area: F-S Curve
alps_shoulder.scope: SKHHLNA010 switch, not the full shoulder lever
alps_shoulder.limitation: F-S curve is listed but not accessed. Lever ratio and contact position remain unknown.

phob_snapback.scope: PhobGCC response processing; mechanism reference, not Xbox firmware
phob_snapback.limitation: Digital filtering must not be confused with mechanical damping.

urdf_joint.scope: Representation only; supplies no Xbox parameters
urdf_joint.limitation: A parsable description is not a calibrated physical asset.

physx_material.locator: PxMaterial setStaticFriction, setDynamicFriction and setFrictionCombineMode; linked PxCombineMode enumeration
physx_material.scope: PhysX contact-material representation: distinct static/dynamic coefficients and the average, min, multiply and max combine modes
physx_material.limitation: Defines simulator fields and constraints only; supplies no Xbox material coefficient or preferred combine mode.

physx_shape_offsets.scope: PhysX shape-offset constraints: contactOffset is finite and non-negative, while restOffset is finite and strictly less than contactOffset
physx_shape_offsets.limitation: Defines backend validity only; it does not supply controller-specific contact offsets.

sapien_collision_groups.locator: set_collision_groups(group0, group1, group2, group3) four-word filtering rule
sapien_collision_groups.scope: SAPIEN four-uint32 collision-filter representation and its exact pairwise allow/ignore formula
sapien_collision_groups.limitation: Defines filter semantics only; it does not choose group words for this controller.

physx_rigid_body_collision.locator: Kinematic Triangle Meshes and Dynamic Triangle Meshes with SDFs
physx_rigid_body_collision.scope: Triangle-mesh simulation support matrix: static and kinematic meshes, query-only shapes, and non-kinematic dynamic meshes cooked with SDF for GPU dynamics
physx_rigid_body_collision.limitation: Defines backend capability and cooking gates only; it supplies no controller collision mesh or SDF parameters.

stick_direction_limit.locator: Operating angle: each direction 23 degrees max
stick_direction_limit.meaning: component maximum, not measured enclosure limit

stick_operating_torque.meaning: operating torque specification, NOT N*m/rad stiffness

stick_return_precision.meaning: plus/minus precision bound, NOT HID deadzone

front_travel.meaning: reference switch travel, not cap height

shoulder_force.meaning: switch force, not finger force on lever
